newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-COLBERT COASTS TO FIFTH WIN ON SENIOR TOUR.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-COLBERT COASTS TO FIFTH WIN ON SENIOR TOUR.

text.p: Jim Colbert breezed to his fifth win of the year on the Senior PGA Tour, a five-shot victory Sunday at the $800,000 Raley's Gold Rush Classic at the Serrano Country Club.

Colbert squandered a two-shot lead to Hale Irwin on the front nine, but recovered with six birdies on the back nine as Irwin faltered. Colbert fired a five-under 67 for a 54-hole total of 14-under 202, five shots better than Dave Stockton.
The victory, worth $120,000, boosted Colbert to the top of the money list with a record sum of $,490,995, $11,001 more than Irwin.
Irwin finished with a final-round 71 to finish fifth at 209, one shot behind Jack Kiefer and Butch Baird.
Colbert has finished first, second, second and first in the last four weeks.
"I tried to drive myself because I finished second the last two weeks," he said. "I was pushing myself because you never know what will happen."
There are two events until the season-ending TOUR Championship, where Colbert is defending champion.
"Irwin has made me play better and I'm pushing him also," said Colbert, who has 18 victories since joining the Senior Tour in 1991.
